name: Superset
description: Runs hundreds of coding agents in parallel from a terminal-first IDE, isolating each in its own git worktree so concurrent work never collides.

skills.name: Parallel Agents
skills.description: Launches many coding agents at once, each confined to an isolated git worktree.

skills.name: Worktree Isolation
skills.description: Creates and tears down per-agent git worktrees so concurrent edits never conflict.

skills.name: Session Review
skills.description: Reviews and merges diffs produced by each agent session before they reach the main branch.
